dialogues.en: I reached out for the clock.
dialogues.text: I reached out for the clock.

dialogues.jp: 寝ぼけまなこに時計を手にとる。
dialogues.en: I shook my head and stood up.
dialogues.text: I shook my head and stood up.

dialogues.en: I opened and closed my hands and checked my own body.
dialogues.text: I opened and closed my hands and checked my own body.

dialogues.jp: 頭を振って立ち上がった。
dialogues.en: "I feel fine now."
dialogues.text: "I feel fine now."

dialogues.jp: 手を握ったり開いたり、全身を見渡してしまう。
dialogues.en: Then, I felt an intense shock in my stomach.
dialogues.text: Then, I felt an intense shock in my stomach.

dialogues.jp: 「今回はなにごともなく起きられたな」
dialogues.en: "I'm so hungry, I need food......"
dialogues.text: "I'm so hungry, I need food......"

dialogues.jp: と、腹部に猛烈な衝動を覚える。
dialogues.en: I shook my head standing up weakly.
dialogues.text: I shook my head standing up weakly.

dialogues.jp: 「……腹へって死にそうだ」
dialogues.en: "Oh, I wonder where Sakura's sleeping."
dialogues.text: "Oh, I wonder where Sakura's sleeping."

dialogues.jp: ふらふら、と立ち上がって頭を振る。
dialogues.en: "I guess she might go home to sleep, but......"
dialogues.text: "I guess she might go home to sleep, but......"

dialogues.jp:
「あ、そういえば、さくらのやつどこで寝てる
　んだ？」
dialogues.en: She might be staying in our house.
dialogues.text: She might be staying in our house.

dialogues.jp:
「さすがに寝るときくらい自分の家に帰っただ
　ろうけど……いや」
dialogues.en: I'm pretty sure she is.
dialogues.text: I'm pretty sure she is.

dialogues.jp: あいつのことだから居るな。
dialogues.en: "She might be in the living room?"
dialogues.text: "She might be in the living room?"

dialogues.jp: 絶対に居るはずだ。
dialogues.en: I stepped down the dark stairs, feeling the wall.
dialogues.text: I stepped down the dark stairs, feeling the wall.

dialogues.jp: 「居間かな」
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp:
真っ暗な廊下と階段を、壁に手をつきながら階
下におりる。
dialogues.en: The lights in the living room were turned on.
dialogues.text: The lights in the living room were turned on.

dialogues.jp: 「あれ？」
dialogues.en: And I heard noise coming out from the kitchen in the back.
dialogues.text: And I heard noise coming out from the kitchen in the back.

dialogues.jp: なぜか居間に電気がついている。
dialogues.en: "Is it the cat, or Sakura?"
dialogues.text: "Is it the cat, or Sakura?"

dialogues.jp:
そして奥の台所からはガサガサ、と冷蔵庫を漁
る音が。
dialogues.en: I looked around the room and called out for it.
dialogues.text: I looked around the room and called out for it.

dialogues.jp: 「猫かさくらか？」
dialogues.en: Ding-a-ling.
dialogues.text: Ding-a-ling.

dialogues.jp: 部屋を見渡しながら声をかける。
dialogues.en: "Niisan?"
dialogues.text: "Niisan?"

dialogues.jp: リリン――
dialogues.en: "Nemu!"
dialogues.text: "Nemu!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん？」
dialogues.en:
"You scared me. What are you doing this time of the night?
Do we have a solar eclipse today?"
dialogues.text:
"You scared me. What are you doing this time of the night?
Do we have a solar eclipse today?"

dialogues.jp: 冷蔵庫の扉の陰から、音夢が立ち上がった。
dialogues.en: Nemu stood up from behind the refrigerator door.
dialogues.text: Nemu stood up from behind the refrigerator door.

dialogues.jp:
「びっくりしたぁ……じゃない！　心配したん
　だぞ！」
dialogues.en: "It's not funny. I was so worried about you!"
dialogues.text: "It's not funny. I was so worried about you!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ご、ごめん……でも、なんでそんなに怒って
　るの？」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry. But, why are you so upset?"
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry. But, why are you so upset?"

dialogues.jp: とことこ、と居間まで来て音夢が首をかしげる。
dialogues.en: Nemu came out to the living room and tilted her head.
dialogues.text: Nemu came out to the living room and tilted her head.

dialogues.jp: 無邪気な顔で。
dialogues.en: "You slept for 3 days!"
dialogues.text: "You slept for 3 days!"

dialogues.jp: 何も知らない、笑顔で。
dialogues.en: "3 days? What day is it today?"
dialogues.text: "3 days? What day is it today?"

dialogues.jp:
見慣れているはずの笑顔が、なぜだか今は無性
に腹が立った。
dialogues.en: I guess she hasn't spoken to Sakura yet.
dialogues.text: I guess she hasn't spoken to Sakura yet.

dialogues.jp: 「いいか、よく聞けよ」
dialogues.en: "It's the 18th. How are you feeling?"
dialogues.text: "It's the 18th. How are you feeling?"

dialogues.jp: 「お前、３日間も眠ったままだったんだぞ！」
dialogues.en: I calmed down and pulled Nemu closer to me.
dialogues.text: I calmed down and pulled Nemu closer to me.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「３日……え、今日って何日？」

惚けたような、信じられないものを見るような
表情で、俺を見つめてくる。
dialogues.en: I covered her forehead with mine.
dialogues.text: I covered her forehead with mine.

dialogues.jp:
どうやら、起きてからさくらには会ってないら
しい。
dialogues.en: "Well, you don't have a fever......"
dialogues.text: "Well, you don't have a fever......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そんな……だって……え？」
dialogues.en: "Niisan......"
dialogues.text: "Niisan......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "We haven't done this for a while."
dialogues.text: "We haven't done this for a while."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: She came close to me whispering.
dialogues.text: She came close to me whispering.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「誰がこんな嘘吐くんだよ！」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, I guess."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, I guess."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そんな……どうして…………」
dialogues.en: "I'm happy. I'm sorry for being stubborn."
dialogues.text: "I'm happy. I'm sorry for being stubborn."

dialogues.jp: ３日間眠り続けていた。
dialogues.en: Her face came even closer to me.
dialogues.text: Her face came even closer to me.

dialogues.jp:
その事実がようやく音夢の中に染み渡ったのだ
ろう。
dialogues.en: "You've always been stubborn......"
dialogues.text: "You've always been stubborn......"

dialogues.jp:
自分自身が信じられないような、そんな風な表
情をしてみせる。
dialogues.en: "I guess you're right."
dialogues.text: "I guess you're right."

dialogues.jp: そして──
dialogues.en:
Nemu was standing on her toes, so I put my hands around her
waist and stooped down a little.
dialogues.text:
Nemu was standing on her toes, so I put my hands around her
waist and stooped down a little.

dialogues.jp: 自分の両肩を抱いて、小さく震え出す。
dialogues.en: We kissed a little bit more aggressively.
dialogues.text: We kissed a little bit more aggressively.

dialogues.jp:
……たぶん、それは無意識にしていることで、
音夢自身は気づいていないのだろう。

そんな音夢を見ていたら、何だか自分の中にあっ
た言いようのないモヤモヤは霧散してしまった。
dialogues.en:
My lips were slightly open, and I rubbed them against her
lips to feel how soft they are.
dialogues.text:
My lips were slightly open, and I rubbed them against her
lips to feel how soft they are.

dialogues.jp: 頭の中が急速に冷めていく。
dialogues.en: This isn't a dream.
dialogues.text: This isn't a dream.

dialogues.en: I shut the rest of my senses out so I can only feel Nemu.
dialogues.text: I shut the rest of my senses out so I can only feel Nemu.

dialogues.jp:
まるで八つ当たりのように、音夢にきつく当たっ
てしまったことを思い出して、なんて言って声
をかけていいのかわからない。
どうしたらいい？
dialogues.en: Our breath was so close, it felt ticklish.
dialogues.text: Our breath was so close, it felt ticklish.

dialogues.jp: わからない。
dialogues.en: Her heartbeat felt so close.
dialogues.text: Her heartbeat felt so close.

dialogues.jp:
（クソッ。こういう時は一体どうしたらいいん
　だよっ！？）
思考だけが無意味に加速していく。
dialogues.en: "Did you stop breathing again?"
dialogues.text: "Did you stop breathing again?"

dialogues.en: "Well...... Yes. I'm not used to it."
dialogues.text: "Well...... Yes. I'm not used to it."

dialogues.jp:
答えを求めるように音夢を見つめて、まなじり
に輝くものを見つけた時、答えがわかった。
dialogues.en: "I see."
dialogues.text: "I see."

dialogues.jp: （……答えはコレしかないじゃないか）
dialogues.en:
We closed our eyes and held onto each other like we were
dancing cheek-to-cheek.
dialogues.text:
We closed our eyes and held onto each other like we were
dancing cheek-to-cheek.

dialogues.jp:
そんな単純な答えに気づけなかった自分に、苛
立ちすら覚える。
dialogues.en: Nemu buried her face into my chest and whispered.
dialogues.text: Nemu buried her face into my chest and whispered.

dialogues.jp: だけど、今は苛立っている場合じゃない。
dialogues.en: "Sure."
dialogues.text: "Sure."

dialogues.jp:
俺は手を伸ばして、自分を抱きしめている音夢
を引き寄せた。
dialogues.en: I held her tightly as she requested.
dialogues.text: I held her tightly as she requested.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Niisan......"
dialogues.text: "Niisan......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「に、兄さん……？」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……大丈夫かよ？」
dialogues.en: We both knew where this is going to lead us.
dialogues.text: We both knew where this is going to lead us.

dialogues.jp: そのまま軽く額を合わせる。
dialogues.en: It made us nervous.
dialogues.text: It made us nervous.

dialogues.jp: 「……熱、ないみたいだな」
dialogues.en: "Are you okay?"
dialogues.text: "Are you okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: I let her go and opened my eyes.
dialogues.text: I let her go and opened my eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「大丈夫そうだな」
dialogues.en: "Ah...... Well...... I'm not sure."
dialogues.text: "Ah...... Well...... I'm not sure."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……兄さん」
dialogues.en: "I guess I'm fine...... But what's it like?"
dialogues.text: "I guess I'm fine...... But what's it like?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ」
dialogues.en: "Mm...... I wouldn't know."
dialogues.text: "Mm...... I wouldn't know."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「久しぶりだよね、これ」
dialogues.en: "Ahahaha...... Right......"
dialogues.text: "Ahahaha...... Right......"

dialogues.jp:
｛ささや／囁｝くように――その声を俺の耳に届かせようと
するかのように音夢が顔を近づける。
dialogues.en: We were so confused we just laughed.
dialogues.text: We were so confused we just laughed.

dialogues.jp: 気がつくと。
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry. I just don't know the details......"
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry. I just don't know the details......"

dialogues.jp: 音夢の震えはおさまっていた。
dialogues.en: "What? Not at all?"
dialogues.text: "What? Not at all?"

dialogues.jp:
もう、音夢を離しても大丈夫だってわかるのに
──なぜだろう？　俺の手は離すことを許さな
かった。
dialogues.en: I asked her back.
dialogues.text: I asked her back.

dialogues.jp: 音夢の方から、キュッと、俺に抱きついてくる。
dialogues.en: "To tell you the truth...... Not at all."
dialogues.text: "To tell you the truth...... Not at all."

dialogues.jp: コツンと──
dialogues.en: Nemu looked down holding her hand over her chest.
dialogues.text: Nemu looked down holding her hand over her chest.

dialogues.jp:
額が胸元に当てられて、波紋が広がるように音
夢の熱が、俺の鼓動が、全身に広がった。
dialogues.en: What?
dialogues.text: What?

dialogues.en: What am I supposed to do?
dialogues.text: What am I supposed to do?

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ごめんね……意地張っちゃってて」
dialogues.en:
"Well, I was trying to avoid things like that... and I
thought you were avoiding it too......"
dialogues.text:
"Well, I was trying to avoid things like that... and I
thought you were avoiding it too......"

dialogues.jp: あの時──
dialogues.en: I see......
dialogues.text: I see......

dialogues.jp:
キスをして、そのままになっていたことの再開
だった。
dialogues.en:
"But you've seen it on that soap opera, when that man and
woman were hugging each other naked, haven't you?"
dialogues.text:
"But you've seen it on that soap opera, when that man and
woman were hugging each other naked, haven't you?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うん。そうだね」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そうだよね……」
dialogues.en: "Uh...... I'm just asking, but have you done it yourself?"
dialogues.text: "Uh...... I'm just asking, but have you done it yourself?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だからまぁ、もう大丈夫だ」
dialogues.en: "No!"
dialogues.text: "No!"

dialogues.jp: 音夢の震えはとまって。
dialogues.en: Nemu dropped her shoulders.
dialogues.text: Nemu dropped her shoulders.

dialogues.jp: こうして目が覚めていて。
dialogues.en:
This isn't a joke, but how could she be so innocent like a
kid?
dialogues.text:
This isn't a joke, but how could she be so innocent like a
kid?

dialogues.jp: こうやって抱き締め合っているのだから。
dialogues.en: I feel like a pedophile.
dialogues.text: I feel like a pedophile.

dialogues.jp: 「……もう、大丈夫だ」
dialogues.en: This is making me nervous in a different sense.
dialogues.text: This is making me nervous in a different sense.

dialogues.jp: そのままふたり、黙って抱きしめ合う。
dialogues.en: "Are you okay?"
dialogues.text: "Are you okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ね、兄さん」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: 潤んだような瞳で、音夢が見上げてくる。
dialogues.en: "Are you still feeling sick?"
dialogues.text: "Are you still feeling sick?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だって……」
dialogues.en: "No...... You decide. Do whatever you want."
dialogues.text: "No...... You decide. Do whatever you want."

dialogues.jp: 涙目の音夢の頬にふれて少し考える。
dialogues.en: I touch Nemu's tear-streaked cheek, and think that...
dialogues.text: I touch Nemu's tear-streaked cheek, and think that...

dialogues.jp: ◆愛の選択◆
dialogues.en: ◆The choice of love◆
dialogues.text: ◆The choice of love◆

dialogues.jp:
夜中に目覚めた俺は、空腹のために降りた階下
で音夢に出会う。
dialogues.en:
I woke up in the middle of the night. I went downstairs to
grab something to eat and I saw Nemu downstairs.
dialogues.text:
I woke up in the middle of the night. I went downstairs to
grab something to eat and I saw Nemu downstairs.

dialogues.jp:
３日間眠りっぱなしだったと音夢に告げると、
音夢は不安そうに震え出す。
dialogues.en:
We both remembered the kiss we had, and we wanted to go
forward from there. But Nemu seems to be still sick.
dialogues.text:
We both remembered the kiss we had, and we wanted to go
forward from there. But Nemu seems to be still sick.

dialogues.jp:
そんな音夢を俺は抱き締めた。それ以外の答え
を知らなくて……。

そして、震えがおさまった音夢は、３日前の続
きを──キスをして欲しいと言うのだった。

choices.jp: ○無理はさせないほうがいいか
choices.en: ○It will be better to make her rest.
choices.text: ○It will be better to make her rest.
